method: Manually estimated projected2D landmarks for visual comparison only. Never drive drawing, deformation or physics. Occluded joints are estimates, not a3D bone-length guarantee.

construction.head: Same spiky hair mass and face volume; no grafted fixed head over mismatched body.
construction.arms: Shoulder-elbow-wrist chains drawn as complete poses; foreshortening changes projected length, never stretch source parts.
construction.legs: Hip-knee-ankle-foot chains; knee flexion supports hip descent, boot size retained.
construction.crouch: Pelvis descends between supporting feet; torso counterbalances; clothing follows the bent joints.
construction.jump: Takeoff load/push, tucked airborne knees and unfolding landing legs; world trajectory is independent.
construction.walking: Alternating support and swing; sole annotations come from real opaque shoe pixels. Held cels can retain residual sliding.
